summary: VHC Talent OS - JD Parsing Feature Backend Testing Complete. Fixed LlmChat integration issue and missing audit field. All 13 tests pass.
passed_tests: ✅ POST /api/jobs/extract-jd-text - Text Extraction Tests:
- TXT file extraction works correctly (txt_read method)
- PDF file extraction works correctly (pdf_fitz method)
- Unsupported file formats (jpg, xyz, etc.) correctly rejected with clear error
- Empty files correctly rejected with 'no text could be extracted' error
- Endpoint requires authentication (returns 401/403 without token)
- Response includes: success, extracted_text, filename, file_type, char_count, extraction_method
- Audit metadata includes: extracted_by, extracted_by_role, extracted_at
✅ POST /api/jobs/parse-jd - JD Parsing Tests:
- Parse with paste input_type works correctly
- Parse with upload input_type works correctly
- Parse requires either jd_text or jd_file (returns 400 if neither provided)
- Endpoint requires authentication (returns 401/403 without token)
- Parse with file upload works correctly
- AI parsing returns structured fields: title, skills, experience, location, salary, summary, etc.
- Audit metadata complete: input_type, parsed_by, parsed_by_name, parsed_by_role, parsed_at
✅ Role-Based Access Control:
- Candidates cannot access extract endpoint (403 Forbidden)
- Admin can access both extract and parse endpoints
- Employer and Recruiter roles have access (per endpoint definition)
